parameters.help_en: The ID of the group
parameters.help_zh: 指定的分组编号
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the API. The name must be unique within the group. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and Chinese characters, and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 设置API的名称，组内不允许重复。支持汉字，英文，数字，下划线，且只能以英文和汉字开头，4~50个字符
parameters.name: api_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the API is public. Valid values:

PUBLIC: public. If you select this value, the online environment definition of the API is visible on the Discover APIs page in the console of all users.
PRIVATE: private. If you select this value and the API group is listed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace, private APIs in the group are not listed
parameters.help_zh:
API是否公开，可以取值：

PUBLIC：公开，如选择此类型，该API的线上环境定义，会在所有用户的控制台“发现API”页面可见。
PRIVATE：不公开，如选择此类型，当该组API在云市场上架时，私有类型的API不会上架
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The description of the API. The description can be up to 180 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: API描述信息，最多180个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The security authentication type of the API. Valid values:

APP: Only authorized applications can call the API.
ANONYMOUS: Anonymous calls are allowed. Note the following when you allow anonymous calls:
  Anyone who can obtain the API service information can call the API. API Gateway does not authenticate the caller and cannot configure user-level throttling. If you make the API public, configure API-level throttling
parameters.help_zh:
API安全认证类型，目前可以取值：

APP：只允许已授权的APP调用
ANONYMOUS：允许匿名调用，设置为允许匿名调用需要注意：
  任何能够获取该API服务信息的人，都将能够调用该API。网关不会对调用者做身份认证，也无法设置按用户的流量控制，若开放该API请设置好按API的流量控制
parameters.name: auth_type

The status of the IP access control feature. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled

parameters.name: open_id_connect_config

parameters.help_en:
The signature algorithm. This parameter is required when AuthType is set to APP. Valid values:
HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
Default value: HmacSHA256
parameters.help_zh:
当AuthType为APP认证时，需要传该值明确签名算法。可选值如下，不传默认是HmacSHA256：

HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
parameters.name: allow_signature_method

parameters.help_en:
The type of the bidirectional communication API. Valid values:

COMMON: common API.
REGISTER: registration API.
UNREGISTER: unregistration API.
NOTIFY: downstream notification API
parameters.help_zh:
双向通信API类型：

COMMON：普通API
REGISTER：注册API
UNREGISTER：注销API
NOTIFY：下行通知
parameters.name: websocket_api_type

parameters.help_en: The response body model of the API
parameters.help_zh: api的返回结果
parameters.name: result_body_model

parameters.help_en:
If ForceNonceCheck is set to true, API Gateway forcibly checks the X-Ca-Nonce parameter in requests. This parameter is a unique identifier for a request and is generally a UUID. API Gateway verifies the validity of this parameter. The same value can be used only once within 15 minutes. This effectively prevents replay attacks on the API.

If ForceNonceCheck is set to false, API Gateway does not check the parameter. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
设置ForceNonceCheck为true, 请求时强制检查X-Ca-Nonce，这个是请求的唯一标识，一般使用UUID来标识。API网关收到这个参数后会校验这个参数的有效性，同样的值，15分内只能被使用一次。可以有效防止API的重放攻击。

设置ForceNonceCheck为false，则不检查。创建API时默认为false
parameters.name: force_nonce_check

parameters.help_en:
If DisableInternet is set to true, the API can be called only over the internal network.
If DisableInternet is set to false, the API can be called over any network. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
设置DisableInternet为true, 仅支持内网调用API。
设置DisableInternet为false, 则不限制调用。创建API时默认为false
parameters.name: disable_internet

parameters.help_en:
The AppCode authentication type. This parameter is valid when AuthType is set to APP. Valid values:

DEFAULT: The default value, which inherits the group setting.
DISABLE: AppCode authentication is not allowed.
HEADER: AppCode authentication in the header is allowed.
HEADER_QUERY: AppCode authentication in the header and query string is allowed
parameters.help_zh:
当AuthType为APP认证时，可选值如下：

DEFAULT：不传默认是DEFAULT（随分组设置）
DISABLE：不允许
HEADER：允许AppCode的Header认证
HEADER_QUERY：允许AppCode的Header及Query认证
parameters.name: app_code_auth_type

parameters.name: backend_id
